in_marathi.name: Rameshwari
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Rama's Grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rameshwari हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Rameshwari is a combination of two words, Rama and Ishwari. Rama is the name of a popular Hindu god, and Ishwari is a term for Goddess or Divine Mother. So, Rameshwari means 'Goddess Rama's Grace'. It is a powerful name that evokes a sense of strength, courage, and femininity.
